releases.notes:
# MMMod 1.0.22

MMMod now uses shared code across all supported versions, making future fixes easier to maintain and test consistently.

- Moved duplicated logic and tests into a shared core, with separate Minecraft/loader adapters.
- Kept each version's existing features, saved data and installation process.
- Added a full build/test matrix for the supported versions.
- Preserved the 1.12.2 Forge + LiteLoader compatibility fix.

Download the file matching your Minecraft version and replace the previous MMM file. No extra core mod is required.

Supported: 1.12.2 LiteLoader, and Fabric 1.17.1, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.6, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3.

This is an internal refactor, not a promise that every older Minecraft version has the same features as 1.21. It introduces no new sync-access or game-mode rules.

Verification: all twelve builds and regression suites passed; the independent core and migration-tool tests passed. Nine versions passed their existing isolated gameplay harnesses. 1.12.2 (with and without Forge), 1.17.1 and 26.1.2 received startup checks rather than full gameplay harness coverage. Authenticated production sync and arbitrary third-party modpacks were not tested. See `docs/1.0.22-verification.md` in the source for details.

The source ZIP contains the whole shared repository. Keep its folders together when rebuilding. The 1.12.2 rebuild ZIP supplies unshaded mod classes, compatibility-library sources and licenses; it is not an installable mod.

releases.notes:
## MMMod 1.0.21 - Minecraft 1.21 Reliability Fixes

- Fixed queued syncs overwriting each other and newer updates being lost after a failed request.
- Separated personal mining totals and records between Minecraft accounts.
- Fixed paused/restored sessions affecting timer and hourly stats, and delayed timer completion screens.
- Improved MMM chat typing, reconnects, and advancement notification retries.
- Fixed lifetime streak retention and block ESP rendering on affected versions.
- Improved live rank and collection estimates so unrelated website changes do not erase new local mining.
- Reduced sync-time disk reads and improved saving during shutdown.

This release is for Minecraft 1.21 with Fabric. Sync access and website approval rules are unchanged.

Replace the old MMM jar in your Minecraft 1.21 instance. Other Minecraft versions are not included in this release.

Legacy personal data without a saved owner is preserved for recovery rather than assigned to a different Minecraft account. Old estimates without world receipts retain their migration behavior; newly recorded mining uses world-scoped sync receipts.

releases.notes:
# MMMod 1.0.20 - Minecraft 1.21.11

- Browse MMM and block leaderboards in-game, with an optional leaderboard sidebar.
- Open the red Collections book from your inventory. Track milestones, view completed tiers, and pin a collection to your HUD.
- Global collections include website worlds and new mining before sync, without counting blocks twice.
- See your collection rank and Top % from synced block rankings, with updated caps and red/green tier panes.
- Share collection milestones in MMM Chat without repeating them after sync.
- Rank-overtake estimates advance as you mine. Session Summary now includes a mining-efficiency breakdown.
- Get a clickable update notice when a newer release is available for your Minecraft version.

For Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer and Java 21. Fabric API is included; Mod Menu is optional. Open settings with X + V.

Collection ranks use synced website data; combined and local-only collections show when ranking is unavailable.

releases.notes:
# MMMod 1.0.20 - Minecraft 26.2

- Brings the latest 1.0.20 features to Minecraft 26.2.
- Browse MMM and block leaderboards in-game, or use a leaderboard as your sidebar.
- Track collections with live progress, updated tiers, red/green completion panes, and HUD pins.
- See collection rank and Top % from synced website rankings.
- Share collection milestones in MMM Chat without repeating them after sync.
- Live rank-overtake estimates, mining efficiency in Session Summary, and clickable update notices.
- Includes MMM advancements, chat tools, HUD, sessions, scoreboard tools, and optional website sync.

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Java 25, and Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer. Fabric API is included; Mod Menu is optional. Open settings with X + V.

Collection rankings use synced website data. Combined and local-only collections show when ranking is unavailable. Website sync remains off by default.
